cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/htslib && cat > /tmp/standalone.c <<'EOF'
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h>
extern int LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(const uint8_t *data, size_t size);
int main(int argc, char **argv){ if(argc<2) return 2; FILE *f=fopen(argv[1],"rb"); if(!f) return 3; fseek(f,0,SEEK_END); long n=ftell(f); fseek(f,0,SEEK_SET); unsigned char *buf=malloc(n? n:1); if(n && fread(buf,1,n,f)!=(size_t)n) return 4; fclose(f); int r=LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput(buf,n); free(buf); return r; }
EOF



make clean >/dev/null 2>&1 || true


CC=clang CFLAGS='-g -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -I.' make -j$(nproc) libhts.a test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.o >/tmp/build.log 2>&1 && clang -g -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer -I. -o /tmp/hts_open_driver /tmp/standalone.c test/fuzz/hts_open_fuzzer.o libhts.a -lz -lbz2 -llzma -lcurl -lcrypto -lpthread && echo built || (tail -80 /tmp/build.log; exit 1)
